In this lab you'll explore the relationship between distance (in miles) and air time (in minutes) of flights out of RDU in 2024.

```{r}
#| eval: false

```

## Question 1 - visualization

Visualize the relationship between `distance` (x) and `air_time` (y) using a scatter plot.
Add a regression line to the scatter plot, but *do not* display the standard error ribbon around the regression line. Comment on the observed relationship.

## Question 2 - point estimation

Estimate the simple linear regression predicting air time from distance. Display the output and interpret the coefficients. 

## Question 3 - interval estimation

Compute a 95% bootstrap interval for the slope of the regression line for predicting `air_time` from `distance`. In your narrative, provide an interpretation of the 95% confidence interval for the slope. Also, don't forget to set a random number seed so that your results are reproducible. Everyone on your team should get exactly the same numbers.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
